nodes.title: GRAPH HOMOMORPHISM as a decision problem

nodes.summary: A graph-homomorphism instance $(n, E, m, F)$ is feasible when there is a map $f : \{0, \dots, n - 1\} \to \{0, \dots, m - 1\}$ such that, for every pair $(u, v)$ in $E$ with $u < n$ and $v < n$, the vertices $f(u)$ and $f(v)$ are adjacent in the target graph of the instance, that is, $f(u) \ne f(v)$ and $(f(u), f(v))$ or $(f(v), f(u))$ belongs to $F$. Pairs of $E$ with an endpoint at least $n$ impose no condition.
nodes.title: Feasible graph-homomorphism instances

nodes.summary: A graph-homomorphism instance is a quadruple $(n, E, m, F)$ where $n$ is a natural number (the number of source vertices), $E$ is a list of pairs of natural numbers (the source edges), $m$ is a natural number (the number of target vertices) and $F$ is a list of pairs of natural numbers (the target edges).
nodes.title: Graph-homomorphism instances

nodes.summary: The decision problem GRAPH HOMOMORPHISM belongs to NP, and every decision problem in NP reduces to it by a polynomial-time many-one reduction.
nodes.title: GRAPH HOMOMORPHISM is NP-complete

nodes.summary: The target graph of a graph-homomorphism instance $(n, E, m, F)$ is the simple graph on $\{0, \dots, m - 1\}$ in which distinct vertices $i$ and $j$ are adjacent when $(i, j)$ or $(j, i)$ belongs to $F$. Pairs of $F$ with an endpoint at least $m$ contribute no edge.
nodes.title: Target graph of a graph-homomorphism instance

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
